title: NASA's Lucy Mission To Jupiter On Track For Asteroid Encounters | Aviation Week
excerpt: NASA’s Lucy spacecraft is approaching Jupiter, where it will carry out the first close-up studies of the primitive Solar System Trojan asteroids.
content:
October 28, 2026

HOUSTON—NASA’s Lucy spacecraft is approaching Jupiter, where it will carry out the first close-up studies of the primitive Solar System’s Trojan asteroids that travel ahead of and trail the giant planet as it orbits the Sun.
